title: Qobuz Curator Playlist Recommendation
description: A service-neutral playlist recommendation that Qobuz Curator can match against the Qobuz catalog.

schema_version.description: The Qobuz Curator interchange schema version.

description.description: A short explanation of the playlist's theme, mood, and progression.

source_prompt.description: The listener's original recommendation request, retained for provenance.

position.description: One-based playback position. Positions must be unique within the playlist.

title.description: The exact recording title, including a version qualifier only when that version is intended.

artists.description: Primary artist first, followed by featured artists when relevant.

album.description: Canonical album or release title. Omit when uncertain.

release_year.description: Original release year for the requested recording. Omit when uncertain.

duration_seconds.description: Recording duration in whole seconds. Omit rather than estimate.

isrc.description: Official ISRC when confidently known. Never invent one; omit when uncertain.

version_hints.description: Short identity constraints such as studio, original album version, not live, or not remix.
